title: DeletionJob
description: Full state of a deletion job, including the per-identifier outcomes.

client_reference.description: The caller-supplied reference from the original request, or null.

identifiers.description: Per-identifier outcomes. Inspect this array to understand exactly what was erased, rather than relying on the top-level status alone.

created_at.description: Time the job was created, in ISO 8601 format.

completed_at.description: Time the job reached a terminal state, in ISO 8601 format, or null while the job is still running.

failure_reason.description: Opaque, machine-readable diagnostic present only when `status` is `failed`, or null otherwise. This value is subject to change; to understand outcomes per identifier, inspect each identifier's `disposition` and `reason`.

DeletionIdentifierType.description: The kind of identifier supplied. `variable_match` selects every end user whose stored variable equals the value.
DeletionIdentifierType.title: DeletionIdentifierType

DeletionJobStatus.description: Lifecycle state of a deletion job. `queued` and `in_progress` are non-terminal; `completed`, `partial`, and `failed` are terminal.
DeletionJobStatus.title: DeletionJobStatus

variable.description: The matched variable name, or null when not applicable.

disposition.description: How the identifier was handled. `accepted` identifiers are queued for erasure; the other values indicate the identifier contributed no erasure.

matched_chatters.description: Number of end users matched by this identifier.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation for a non-accepted disposition. Always set for `invalid` and `exceeds_limit`, and for `not_found` on ID-based identifiers; may be null for a `not_found` `email` or `variable_match` selector, and for `accepted`/`duplicate`. Do not assume it is non-null from `disposition` alone.

IdentifierDisposition.description: The outcome for one submitted identifier.
IdentifierDisposition.title: IdentifierDisposition

IdentifierDispositionDisposition.description: How the identifier was handled. `accepted` identifiers are queued for erasure; the other values indicate the identifier contributed no erasure.
IdentifierDispositionDisposition.title: IdentifierDispositionDisposition
